title: The nature of operations
overview: A focused revision guide to the nature of operations.

sections.title: Production methods
content: Job production — one-off, highly customised, high skill/cost. Batch production — groups of identical items, flexible but needs changeover time. Flow production — continuous, standardised, high volume, low unit cost but inflexible.

examTips: Always weigh cost against benefit when recommending a production method — "flow production is best" without discussing capital cost and flexibility trade-offs won't get top marks.
